verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows GitHub publishing its own MCP server (github-mcp-server) so other agents can call GitHub's tools — that is GitHub acting as an MCP server/provider, not as a client that plugs external MCP servers into itself (e.g., Copilot) to gain new tools. No documentation or community report shows Copilot or another GitHub surface consuming third-party MCP servers as tools. missing for 10: evidence that GitHub/Copilot can configure and call external MCP servers as tool providers, independent confirmation of such client-side MCP usage.
